_comment: PromptMaker model profiles. Edit or add entries; restart or click Reload in the app. format: natural|tags|hybrid|json; negative: supported|optional|limited|unsupported|param_no; weighting: parens|mj|none; param_style: midjourney|settings|none.

profiles.name: Generic (any model)
profiles.ai_guidance: Write a clear, comma-separated or sentence-style description: subject first, then setting, style, lighting, camera, mood.
tips: Subject first, then setting, style, lighting, camera.

profiles.name: FLUX.2 (pro / max / dev / klein)
profiles.settings: Any size in multiples of 16, ≤4 MP (≤2 MP recommended). prompt_upsampling on by default in the API (disable_pup to turn off).
profiles.ai_guidance: FLUX.2: write rich natural-language prose, most important element first: subject, action, setting, style, lighting, camera/lens, mood. Put exact text in quotes. No weighting syntax, no negative prompt; describe what you want instead. Hex colours are allowed.
tips: Natural language or structured JSON (scene, subjects, style, color_palette, lighting, mood, background, composition, camera).
No negative prompt – phrase exclusions positively.
Hex colour codes are understood.

profiles.name: FLUX.2 – JSON structured
profiles.settings: Paste the JSON as the prompt string. Multiples of 16, ≤4 MP.
profiles.ai_guidance: Output a FLUX.2 JSON prompt with keys scene, subjects[{description,position,action}], style, color_palette, lighting, mood, background, composition, camera{angle,lens,depth_of_field}. Output only the JSON.
tips: Best for complex multi-subject scenes and automation.

profiles.name: FLUX.1 [dev / schnell / pro]
profiles.settings: dev: ~28 steps, guidance ~3.5; schnell: 1–4 steps. ~1 MP, multiples of 16. T5 encoder ≈512 tokens.
profiles.ai_guidance: FLUX.1: descriptive natural-language sentences, subject first. No (word:1.2) weighting, no negative prompt, avoid tag soup and 'masterpiece/8k' filler.
tips: Weighting syntax and negative prompts are ignored (guidance-distilled).
Quality tags like 'masterpiece' add little.

profiles.name: FLUX.1 Kontext (image editing)
profiles.settings: Requires an input image. Describe the edit as an instruction.
profiles.ai_guidance: FLUX.1 Kontext is an instruction-based editor: write a direct edit instruction ('Change X to Y while keeping Z the same'). Name what must be preserved (face, pose, composition). Put exact text in quotes. Be specific rather than using pronouns.
tips: Write instructions, not scene descriptions.
State explicitly what to keep unchanged.
Do edits step by step.

profiles.name: Stable Diffusion XL 1.0
profiles.negative_default: lowres, blurry, worst quality, low quality, deformed, bad anatomy, extra fingers, watermark, text, signature, jpeg artifacts
profiles.settings: ~1 MP buckets (e.g. 1024x1024, 1216x832). 25–40 steps, CFG 5–8. CLIP limit ≈77 tokens per chunk.
profiles.ai_guidance: SDXL: comma-separated descriptive phrases, most important first; (term:1.2) weighting allowed up to ~1.5; keep under ~75 tokens; style and quality keywords help.
tips: Use (term:1.2) to emphasise.
Negative prompt strongly recommended.
Keep within ~75 tokens per chunk.

profiles.name: Stable Diffusion 3.5 (Large / Medium)
profiles.negative_default: blurry, low quality, deformed, watermark, text
profiles.settings: ~1 MP. Large: 28–40 steps, CFG 3.5–4.5. T5 encoder handles long natural prompts.
profiles.ai_guidance: SD 3.5: natural-language description with style, subject, composition, lighting and quoted text. Negative prompt works but keep it short. Avoid heavy weighting.
tips: Write full sentences; it understands long prompts.
Quote text you want rendered.

profiles.name: Pony Diffusion V6 XL (tags)
profiles.negative_default: score_6, score_5, score_4, worst quality, low quality, bad anatomy, watermark
profiles.settings: SDXL resolutions. CLIP skip 2. Euler a, ~25 steps, CFG ~7. Add source_anime / source_cartoon / source_furry to steer.
profiles.ai_guidance: Pony Diffusion V6: start with 'score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up', optionally a source_ tag, then Danbooru-style comma-separated lowercase tags. (tag:1.2) weighting allowed.
tips: Start with score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up.
Use source_anime / source_cartoon / rating_safe tags.

profiles.name: Illustrious XL / NoobAI (Danbooru tags)
profiles.quality_prefix: masterpiece, best quality, amazing quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
profiles.negative_default: worst quality, low quality, bad anatomy, bad hands, jpeg artifacts, watermark, signature
profiles.settings: SDXL resolutions (1–1.5 MP). Euler a, 20–30 steps, CFG 5–7.
profiles.ai_guidance: Illustrious/NoobAI: Danbooru tags, comma separated, lowercase: quality tags, count (1girl), character, series, artist, then general tags. Weighting (tag:1.2) allowed.
tips: Use Danbooru tag names (1girl, long hair, looking at viewer).
Quality tags at the start, artist tags help style.

profiles.name: Anima (CircleStone Labs, anime)
profiles.negative_default: worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, artist name, blurry, jpeg artifacts, bad anatomy, bad hands
profiles.settings: Base/Aesthetic: 30–50 steps, CFG 4–5, er_sde sampler. Turbo: CFG 1, 8–12 steps. ~1 MP.
profiles.ai_guidance: Anima: anime/illustration only (not photoreal). Lowercase Danbooru tags with spaces not underscores (only score_ tags use underscores), ordered quality/meta/year/safety -> subject count -> character -> series -> @artist -> general tags; then add at least two natural-language sentences describing the scene. Weights like (tag:1.2) may need 1.2–1.4.
tips: Lowercase tags, spaces instead of underscores (except score_ tags).
Prefix artists with @.
Combine tags with 2+ sentences of natural language.
Avoid photorealism.

profiles.name: MOSS-Image (OpenMOSS, 5B)
profiles.negative_default: nsfw, worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact
profiles.settings: Official: 50 steps, CFG 3, skip-layer guidance at layer 22. ComfyUI template: 25 steps, CFG 2.5, er_sde. 1–2 MP, multiples of 16. Prompts up to ~4K tokens.
profiles.ai_guidance: MOSS-Image: write a detailed caption describing the finished image (not a request). English preferred, Chinese supported. Quote exact text to render; use line breaks for text layout. Tags also work in order quality -> score -> meta -> year -> character -> series -> @artist -> general. Keep the negative prompt short.
tips: Describe the finished image, not an instruction.
Quote rendered text; add \n for line breaks.
JSON layout prompts with bounding boxes give precise placement.

profiles.name: Qwen-Image (incl. 2512)
profiles.settings: 50 steps, true_cfg_scale 4. Negative prompt has little effect – write exclusions into the main prompt ('no text, no watermark').
profiles.ai_guidance: Qwen-Image: long, detailed natural-language paragraphs (English or Chinese); excellent text rendering, quote text exactly. Put exclusions in the positive prompt rather than a negative prompt.
tips: Excellent bilingual text rendering – quote it.
Write exclusions positively in the prompt.

profiles.name: HiDream-I1 (Full / Dev / Fast)
profiles.settings: Full: 50 steps, CFG 5, shift 3 (negative prompt works). Dev: 28 steps, CFG 1, shift 6. Fast: 16 steps, CFG 1. Negatives ignored on Dev/Fast.
profiles.ai_guidance: HiDream-I1: natural-language description; no weighting or brackets; quote text; strong artist/style knowledge so named styles work.
tips: No (term:1.2) weighting or brackets.
Negative prompt only works on Full.

profiles.name: Midjourney V7
profiles.settings: Parameters go at the end: --ar, --stylize/--s, --chaos/--c, --exp 0–100 (5–25 when mixing with --stylize), --raw, --draft, --sref, --sw, --no.
profiles.ai_guidance: Midjourney V7: clear natural-language sentences with the main subject first and specific style details at the end; avoid long keyword lists. Keep any --parameters at the very end, unchanged.
tips: Main subject first; full sentences.
--exp 5–25 adds detail; --raw for literal adherence.
--sref for style reference images.

profiles.name: OpenAI GPT Image 2 / 2.5
profiles.settings: model gpt-image-2.5-sunburst (quality) or -flare (speed); quality auto/low/medium/high/xhigh/max; sizes multiples of 16, ≤3840 per edge, ratio ≤3:1. (gpt-image-1 retired 23 Oct 2026.)
profiles.ai_guidance: GPT Image: write it like a creative brief: the intended use, subject, composition, visible details (materials, lighting, medium), people/actions, exact text in quotes, then constraints such as 'No extra text, no watermarks'. Labelled sections are fine.
tips: State exclusions as constraints in the prompt.
Quote exact text and say how many times it appears.

profiles.name: Google Imagen 4 (Fast / Standard / Ultra)
profiles.settings: Aspect ratios 1:1, 3:4, 4:3, 9:16, 16:9 only. Standard/Ultra up to 2K (2816x1536); Fast up to 1408x768.
profiles.ai_guidance: Imagen 4: descriptive natural language – subject, context/background, style; add photography modifiers (lens, lighting) for realism; quote text. No negative prompt.
tips: Only 1:1, 3:4, 4:3, 9:16, 16:9 aspect ratios.
